subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

This book is written by a __famous __author named G.H. Sullivan.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"famous"** means known about by many people. (प्रसिद्ध)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a famous singer known worldwide for her exceptional voice.
 
 
 
• **"Unknown" **refers to something or someone that is not known or familiar. (अज्ञात)
 
 
• **Example: **The author of this ancient manuscript remains unknown.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'famous' **is **'unknown'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Illiterate **(निरक्षर): Unable to read or write.

 
 
• **Example:** In the past, many people were illiterate due to lack of access to education.
 
 
 
• **Illegible **(अस्पष्ट): Not clear enough to be read.
 
 
• **Example: **The handwriting on the note was so illegible that I couldn't read it.
 
 
 
• **Uniform** (एकरूप): Remaining the same in all cases and at all times.
 
 
• **Example:** The students wore a uniform dress code to maintain equality.
